title: Seal a filled carton with a tape gun: tape along the seam, tear it off, smooth both tabs down
context: Sealing filled cartons with a hand tape gun is a core, all-day task of hand packers and packagers, stockers and order fillers, and material movers. The strip has to run straight along the seam with the flaps flat under it (closed flaps spring back up a little), lap down both end faces as tabs smoothed on so it does not peel back, and be torn off on the gun's blade.
setup: Bench top is z = 0. Carton of 4 mm corrugated board, 160 x 160 x 50 mm outside, filled (2.5 kg, plus its flaps), centred at x 0.25, y -0.05 m, not fixed. Its two long top flaps (160 x 79 mm, 30 g each), hinged along the left and right top edges, are folded down over the two short end flaps but spring back up about 10 degrees, so the seam, along x at y -0.05, gapes. Hand tape gun (350 g): red steel frame, 48 mm tan packing tape on an 80 mm roll, a 22 mm rubber pressure roller on a free axle at the front with the serrated blade just ahead of it, and a 34 x 28 x 45 mm grip behind the roll; 75 mm of tape is free past the roller. It stands on its roller and foot at x 0.17, y -0.22, front facing +x.
scoring: Measured with a rule along the strip: 0.25 tape stuck along at least half the seam. 0.5 stuck along the whole 160 mm seam, its centreline within 10 mm of the seam everywhere, and torn off. 0.75 also tabs stuck at least 24 mm down both 50 mm end faces. 1.0 also both flaps flat (neither more than 3 degrees open where the tape went on, nor at the end), the gun let go of, both hands clear of the carton, held 1 s.
fidelity: PhysX 240 Hz. Tape is 8 mm cells, not a film: a cell sticks where the measured roller axle runs within 3 mm of its height on the board; hanging ends stick cell by cell where a fingertip smooths them down an end face. Run 8 mm past the far edge and lifted 12 mm, the tape tears (a position rule; tail up to 60 mm). Rigid flaps on spring hinges are set closed once 3 cells hold. The roller turns on a free axle. No adhesion or tension.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0 after 129 steps (6.45 simulated seconds); termination: DreamSessionExpired:expired. Scripted/teleoperated demo: 1 after 574 steps.
